PreToolUse.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND" | grep -qE 'git\s+commit'; then PROJECT_PATH=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND" | grep -oP '(?<=--project\s)\S+' || pwd); DATA_DIR=''; for d in /mnt/c/Users/kamwoh/Documents/Projects/Godot/FF9 /mnt/c/Users/kamwoh/Documents/Projects/Godot/Yume3D; do if [ -d "$d/data/locations" ]; then DATA_DIR="$d"; break; fi; done; if [ -n "$DATA_DIR" ]; then echo '[Hook] Pre-commit: running yume test on data...'; cd /home/kamwoh/yume && python3 tools/validate_game_data.py "$DATA_DIR/data" 2>&1 | tail -5; fi; fi

PostToolUse.command: if [ "$TOOL_EXIT_CODE" != "0" ] && [ -n "$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND" ]; then ERROR_SIG=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND" | md5sum | cut -c1-8); LEARN_LOG='/home/kamwoh/yume/.claude/error_log.jsonl'; if [ -f "$LEARN_LOG" ] && grep -q "$ERROR_SIG" "$LEARN_LOG" 2>/dev/null; then COUNT=$(grep -c "$ERROR_SIG" "$LEARN_LOG"); if [ "$COUNT" -ge 2 ]; then echo "[Hook] Same command failed ${COUNT}+ times. Consider: yume learn to save this as a lesson."; fi; fi; echo "{\"sig\":\"$ERROR_SIG\",\"cmd\":\"$(echo $TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND | head -c 100)\",\"ts\":\"$(date -Is)\"}" >> "$LEARN_LOG" 2>/dev/null; fi
